title: Revise the SLA Policy
subtitle: Add slack after a near-miss - versioned
scenario: After a laptop nearly missed a start date, People Ops revised the SLA policy: hardware now has more slack, due 2 business days before start instead of 1. Record the revised, versioned policy - a governed change, not a quiet edit.
input: Revision after a near-miss: hardware moves from SD-1 to SD-2 so a slow delivery has a day of margin. Unchanged: payroll SD-3 (earliest, for the pay cycle), accounts SD-2, access SD-1. Owned by the People Ops Lead. Bump the version to 1.1.0.
instructions: Set the four deadlines as plain numbers of business days before start.
Move hardwareSla to 2 (the added slack); keep payroll 3, accounts 2, access 1.
Record the owner and bump version to 1.1.0.
Payroll stays earliest, so payrollSla must exceed accessSla, then validate.
copilotPrompt: Draft a revised onboarding SLA policy: hardwareSla now 2 (more slack), payrollSla 3, accountsSla 2, accessSla 1, owner People Ops Lead, version 1.1.0. Payroll stays the earliest.
successMessage: Policy revised and versioned. Hardware now has a day of slack, and the change is tracked.
editorHelper: A governed change: revise the number, bump the version.

intro.heading: Before you plan: policy learns too

sections.title: Rules change with evidence
sections.body: A near-miss is data. Moving hardware to SD-2 builds in margin so a slow shipment does not become a missed start. Governance is how a lesson becomes a rule.

sections.title: Version every change
sections.body: Bumping to 1.1.0 keeps the policy auditable: what changed, when, and why. A quiet edit to a deadline is how nobody remembers the rule six months later.

sections.title: Ordering still holds
sections.body: Payroll stays earliest for the pay cycle. Changing one deadline must not break the dependencies the ordering encodes.

sections.title: What you produce here
sections.body: A revised, versioned SLA policy the plan applies - now with hardware slack.

takeaway.heading: Policy revised
points: You added hardware slack (SD-2) after a near-miss - a governed change.
The version bump to 1.1.0 keeps the revision auditable.
Payroll stays earliest; the ordering dependency held.
The plan will apply the revised deadlines automatically.
The workflow can now evolve its deadlines from real onboarding experience.
